_comment: Per-step DiT latency profiles for the CP/DP hotswitch simulator. All numbers are anchored to measured DiT-forward latencies in this repo, not fabricated. Sources: ChituBench/result_parallel_dit.md (flux1_dev_sequence_parallel, flux2_klein_sequence_parallel, qwen_image_parallel) and experiments/fast_cp/worklog.md. Per-step ms = measured DiT-forward mean (s) * 1000 / denoise steps. dp1 = single-GPU baseline; cp2 = 2-GPU context parallel (pure CP, not CFG parallel); cp4 = 4-GPU context parallel.

profiles.name: flux1_1024
profiles._source: ChituBench flux1_dev_sequence_parallel: baseline_1gpu 38.027s, ring_2gpu 20.860s, ulysses_4gpu 11.580s over 50 steps.

profiles.name: flux2_klein_1024
profiles._source: ChituBench flux2_klein_sequence_parallel: baseline_1gpu 1.358s, ring_2gpu 0.732s, ulysses_4gpu 0.409s over 4 steps (distilled).

profiles.name: qwen_1328
profiles._source: ChituBench qwen_image_parallel: baseline_1gpu 138.819s, pure CP2 cfp1up2_2gpu 80.935s over 50 steps. cp4 pure-CP point not measured in isolation (only CFG+CP), left null.
